task: review-run snapshot signing and consumer freshness recompute material/story hashes from signedWorkspaceRoot instead of the resolved metadataRoot, so a wrapper-root custom-storyDir metadata-only commit false-stales the reviewer run.
outcome: In a wrapper-root project with a custom storyDir, after making a metadata-only commit to that storyDir and resubmitting reviewer evidence, `lattice finding_add` / `review_pass_set` no longer fails with `review evidence for <lane> bound reviewRunId <id> is stale: evidence storyFilesHash does not match current story-owned file state` — the reviewer run is accepted and REVIEW->TEST proceeds. Plain-repo / default-storyDir projects behave byte-identically. The new durable test prints its pass line and `lattice validate` reports all green.
facts: captureReviewRunSnapshot (core/review-run.ts:310-321) computes materialHash=currentMaterialHash(projectRoot) and storyFilesHash=currentStoryFilesHash(projectRoot), both defaulting metadataRoot to projectRoot; the handler (handlers/review-run.ts:102) passes signedWorkspaceRoot only.

buildReviewRunWorkspaceBinding (core/review-run.ts:177-178) recomputes storyFilesHash with metadataRoot only when input.storyFilesHash is empty; the handler always passes the precomputed value, so that fallback is dead on this path.

assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence (core/review-run.ts:686-692) and validateEvidenceRunBinding (core/review-run.ts:825-832) call checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit(signedProjectRoot, head, material, signedProjectRoot, story) — signed root passed as the metadataRoot arg.

evidence-freshness.ts currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash/checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit use metadataRoot via isMaterialExcludedPath -> isStoryMetadataPath -> loadConfig(metadataRoot); config.ts loadConfig(root) reads root/lattice.config.json for the custom storyDir.
ReviewRunWorkspaceBinding persists metadataRoot (types.ts:1752), sourced at handler:110 from workspace.metadataRoot || ctx.root.
done-oracle.ts:205, done-prepare.ts:351, verifier.ts:400 already thread a distinct metadataRoot; review-run is the only freshness consumer collapsing gitCwd and metadataRoot (B-6666 F-001 precedent).

constraints: Plain-repo / default-storyDir behavior must stay byte-identical: metadataRoot defaults to projectRoot; signReviewRun / workspace-binding signatures unchanged for the default case.
